hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '(\.pb\.go|mock_.*\.go)$'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Do not edit generated files (*.pb.go, mock_*.go). Regenerate with make generated-proto or make generate-mockery.' && exit 1; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.go$' && ! echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '(\.pb\.go|mock_.*\.go)$'; then cd /home/chyezh/repository/chyezh/milvus && ./bin/gofumpt -w $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS 2>/dev/null || true; fi
